title: A* pathfinding (grid)
description: A* on a boolean grid. Import { findPath } from './ai-astar.js': findPath(blocked(x,y)→bool, [sx,sy], [gx,gy], {w,h,diagonal}) → [[x,y]…] or null. Default script walks its entity along a path to the clicked tile on a grid with solid-tagged obstacles.

title: Behaviour tree (lite)
description: Minimal behaviour tree: sequence/selector/inverter/action/condition nodes returning 'success'|'failure'|'running'. Import { sequence, selector, action, cond, run } from './ai-behaviour-tree.js'. The default script runs a sample tree: flee when the player is near, else wander.

title: Boss with phases
description: Boss pattern controller: phases switch at health thresholds (phases: [{at:0.66, move:'strafe', fire:{rate,burst,spread}}]). Reads the sibling Health script, strafes/charges and fires bullet prefabs. Emits 'boss:phase' and 'boss:dead'.

title: Enemy AI: chase
description: Chases the nearest tagged target when it is within sight range, gives up beyond lose range, optionally keeps distance (kiting). Contact damage via the target's 'damage' event.

title: Flocking (boids)
description: Boids steering: separation, alignment, cohesion with all entities that share a tag, optional attraction to a target. Add to each member; all members use the shared tag.

title: State machine (FSM)
description: Tiny finite-state-machine helper: new FSM({idle:{enter,update,exit,next}}, 'idle'). Import it from this file in your own scripts: `import { FSM } from './ai-fsm.js'`. The default-exported script demonstrates it by cycling idle→walk with a timer.

title: Enemy AI: patrol
description: Walks back and forth over a distance, turning at walls/ledge ends (checks ground ahead with overlapBox) and pauses at the ends.

title: Enemy AI: shooter / turret
description: Aims at the nearest tagged target in range and fires a bullet prefab at a fixed rate with optional spread and burst; leads moving targets if 'lead' is on.

title: Follow waypoint path
description: Moves along a 'path' component on this or another entity (by name) at a speed; loops or ping-pongs. Great for tower-defense creeps and patrols.

title: Audio player + visualiser
description: Playlist player with play/pause, seek, volume and a WebAudio frequency-bar visualiser. mount(root,{tracks:[{title,src}]}).

title: Calculator
description: Four-function calculator with percent, sign and keyboard input. Safe evaluation (no eval).

title: Dashboard + charts
description: KPI tiles plus tiny dependency-free canvas charts (line, bar, donut). Export lineChart/barChart/donutChart for reuse. mount(root, {data}) with {kpis:[{label,value,delta}], series:{labels,values}}.

title: JSON / CSV viewer
description: Paste or open a JSON or CSV file: JSON renders as a collapsible tree, CSV as a sortable table. mount(root, {text}).

title: Kanban board
description: Three-column board (To do / Doing / Done) with HTML5 drag & drop, add/delete cards, persisted in localStorage.

title: Markdown notes
description: Notes list with live Markdown preview (headings, bold, italic, code, lists, links; uses window.marked if loaded, else a tiny built-in renderer). Saved in localStorage.

title: Paint
description: Canvas drawing: brush, eraser, size, colour, undo, clear and PNG download. Pointer events (mouse, pen, touch).

title: Router + state mini-framework
description: ~60-line SPA core: hash router (routes with :params), reactive store with subscribe(), and mount helper. createApp({routes}) → app.start(root). Use for multi-page UI apps without dependencies.

title: Todo list
description: Add, complete, filter and delete tasks; persists in localStorage. mount(root, {key}) renders into any element.

title: Cinematic camera path
description: Moves this entity along a sibling 'path' component over a duration with easing; emits 'cinematicDone' on the global bus. Trigger by calling play() or setting autoplay.

title: Camera follow (lerp + deadzone + look-ahead)
description: Put on the camera entity: smoothly follows a target (by name or tag) with a deadzone and optional look-ahead in the movement direction, clamped to world bounds.

title: Camera follow (3D rig)
description: Chase camera for 3D: keeps an offset from a target entity (by name), smoothing position. Put on a camera entity (non-orbit) — it looks at the target.

title: Camera shake on event
description: Shakes the camera whenever a global event fires (default 'hit'). Event payload may be a number to scale the intensity. 3D: shakes this entity's position instead.

title: Camera zoom (wheel / actions)
description: Zoom the 2D camera with the 'zoomIn'/'zoomOut' actions, smoothly, within limits.

title: Top-down car
description: Arcade top-down car with steering that scales with speed and sideways grip (drift). Actions up/down accelerate/brake, left/right steer.

title: Click to move
description: Walk to the clicked world position at a fixed speed; emits 'arrived' on the entity when done.

title: Flappy flap
description: One-button flap: each 'jump' press sets upward velocity; tilts with velocity. Emits 'dead' on any collision.

title: Follow pointer
description: Moves the entity toward the pointer at a maximum speed.

title: Grid / tile mover
description: Moves one tile per key press with a short slide tween. Set 'blocked' tag on obstacles; emits 'step' on the global bus after each move.

title: Ladder climb
description: Add to the player next to a platformer controller: overlapping an entity tagged 'ladder' lets up/down climb and disables gravity pull while climbing.

title: Mouse aim
description: Rotates the entity (z) to face the pointer. Offset the angle if the sprite does not face +x.

title: Platformer 2D
description: Side-scroller controller: run, coyote time, jump buffer, variable jump height, wall slide/jump and dash. Needs actions left/right/jump (+ optional dash).

title: Auto-runner
description: Side-scroll auto-runner: runs right at increasing speed, jump (and optional slide) actions. Emits 'dead' on the global bus when hitting something tagged 'hazard'.

title: Swim / fly
description: Free 2D movement with floaty damping: use for swimming or flying characters. Optionally hold 'jump' to rise.

title: Tank controls
description: Rotate with left/right, drive forward/back with up/down. The sprite should face +x.

title: Top-down mover
description: 4- or 8-direction top-down movement with acceleration. Actions left/right/up/down. Falls back to direct movement without a rigidbody.

title: Twin-stick shooter
description: Move with left/right/up/down, aim at the pointer, fire a prefab with the 'fire' action (or pointer). Spawned prefab gets a velocity via its own script, or is moved here when it has none.

title: Click to move (3D)
description: Click the ground to walk there (uses game.pick). Turns to face the target. Emits 'arrived' on the entity.

title: Fly camera
description: Free-fly camera: WASD + up/down (actions 'ascend'/'descend'), mouse-drag look, 'sprint' to go faster. Put on the camera entity.

title: FPS controller
description: First-person: WASD (left/right/up/down actions), mouse look (click for pointer lock), jump, sprint, crouch and head-bob. Put a camera entity as a child of this entity (at eye height) — it is pitched by this script.

title: Interaction ray
description: Casts a ray forward from the entity; when you press 'interact' the hit entity gets its 'interact' event (and onInteract() on its scripts). Emits 'focus' with the hovered entity.

title: Marble roll
description: Push a sphere around with the direction actions (forces relative to world axes), jump when grounded. Emits 'fell' on the global bus below killY.

title: Orbit camera (auto)
description: Slowly auto-rotates an orbit camera around its target (turntable/showroom); pauses while the user drags. Put on the entity with the camera component (type 'orbit').

title: 3D platformer
description: World-axis movement (works with a fixed or follow camera looking down +z): coyote time, jump buffer, variable jump height, double jump.

title: RTS camera
description: Top-down strategy camera rig: pan with WASD or screen edges, rotate with 'rotateLeft'/'rotateRight' actions. Put on a pivot entity that has the camera as a child (angled down).

title: Spaceship 6DOF
description: Newtonian-ish ship: thrust forward/back, strafe, ascend/descend, pitch/yaw/roll with actions pitchUp/pitchDown/left/right/rollLeft/rollRight/up/down. Velocity damps slowly.

title: Third-person controller
description: Camera-relative movement with an orbiting follow camera (drag mouse to orbit). The character turns toward its movement direction. Needs a camera component with type 'orbit'.

title: Arcade vehicle (3D)
description: Simple arcade car on a single rigid body: throttle/brake with up/down, steer with left/right, hand-brake with 'jump'. Sideways velocity is damped for grip. Model should face +z.

title: CRT / scanline overlay
description: Pure-CSS CRT look on the UI layer: scanlines, vignette and subtle flicker, with no shader dependency (works on both runtimes). Toggle with events 'crt:toggle'.

title: Hit-stop, slow-mo, flash
description: Game-feel events: 'hitstop' (ms) freezes time briefly, 'slowmo' ({scale,time}) eases timeScale, 'flash' flashes the screen. Also reacts to the global 'hit' event with a tiny hit-stop.

title: Parallax layers (manual)
description: Moves this background entity at a fraction of the camera/target movement for depth, with optional auto-scroll (clouds). Use the built-in 'parallax' component for tiled textures; use this for individual sprites.

title: Particle presets
description: Applies a named preset (fire, smoke, sparks, explosion, rain, snow, magic, hit, dust, coin, confetti) to this entity's particles component by rebuilding it. Also export PRESETS to use with entity.addComponent('particles', PRESETS.fire).

title: Post-FX presets (3D)
description: Switch the postProcess component between looks at runtime: 'clean', 'cinematic' (bloom+vignette+ACES), 'retro' (grain+chromatic aberration), 'dream' (heavy bloom). Events 'postfx:set' name.

title: Trail / afterimage
description: Leaves fading afterimage clones of the entity's sprite as it moves (spawns clones of its own data, fades them with a tween). Great for dashes.

title: Tween fade-out
description: Fade the entity out then destroy it. Paste into a script method.

title: Checkpoints & respawn
description: Put on every checkpoint trigger entity: touching one sets the respawn point; when the global 'died' event fires (or y passes killY) the player is moved back and healed after a delay. Emits 'checkpoint' and 'respawned'.

title: Timers & cooldowns
description: Countdown/count-up timer (shows mm:ss in the HUD) plus named cooldowns: cooldowns.start('dash', 0.5) / cooldowns.ready('dash'). Emits 'timer:done' when a countdown ends.

title: Crafting & shop
description: Recipes {out,n,needs:{id:n}} crafted from an Inventory script on the same entity: craft(recipeId). Shop mode: buy(itemId) spends the 'coin' item. Emits 'crafted'/'bought'.

title: Dialogue (branching, typewriter)
description: Branching dialogue from a JSON asset ({start, nodes:{id:{speaker,text,next|choices:[{text,next}]}}}). Typewriter text in a DOM box, choices as buttons, 'interact' advances. Start with start() or the global event 'dialogue:start' (payload = node id).

title: Health & damage
description: Hit points with damage/heal, invulnerability frames with blink, death handling. Listens for the entity 'damage' event {amount}; emits 'health' {hp,max} on the entity and global 'died' when it hits 0.

title: Inventory (stacks + equip)
description: Slot-based inventory with stacking, add/remove/has/count, equip slots and save/load. Items are {id, name, max?, slot?}. Emits 'inventory' {items} on the global bus. Other scripts call entity.getScript(Inventory).

title: Keys, doors, switches
description: A lock: opens (disables and hides itself, emits 'open' on the entity) when the toucher's inventory has the key item, or when a linked switch entity fires 'toggle'. Also usable as a pressure plate/lever via mode 'switch'.

title: Loot tables
description: Weighted drops: on the entity's 'death' event (or drop()), spawn prefabs chosen from a table [{prefab, weight, min?, max?}] with an overall drop chance.

title: Pickups & power-ups
description: Put on collectible entities: when the player touches it, emits a global event (default 'score' + value), or applies a power-up (heal / speed / shield via entity events), plays a sound and disappears with a pop tween. Magnetises toward the player when close.

title: Quest tracker
description: Quest log driven by events: define quests as {id,title,goal:{event,count}}; each matching global event increments progress. Emits 'quest:update' and 'quest:done'. Persists to the save slot.

title: Save / load slots
description: Saves the position and custom data of tagged entities into numbered slots and restores them. Events: 'game:save' (slot), 'game:load' (slot). Uses save.slot(n) (localStorage).

title: Score, combo & high score
description: Score counter with a combo multiplier that decays, persistent high score and a HUD label. Add points via the global event 'score' (number) or addScore(n).

title: Status effects
description: Timed effects on an entity: poison/burn (damage over time), regen, slow, haste, stun. Entity events: apply {type,duration,power}. Reads entity.speedMul / entity.stunned for controllers; DoT is delivered as 'damage' events.

title: Wave spawner
description: Spawns waves of prefabs around/at this entity: wave n has count = base + n*growth. Waits for the wave to be cleared (or a timer), emits 'wave:start' {n}, 'wave:clear' and 'wave:all-done'.

title: XP, levels & skills
description: Experience and level-ups with a curve (base * level^exp), skill points and a stat table. Global event 'xp' adds experience. Emits 'levelup' {level,points}.

title: Bounce pad
description: Launches whatever enters the trigger upward with a fixed speed and plays a sound.

title: Water / buoyancy zone
description: A water trigger: bodies inside float upward and are slowed (drag). Gravity-direction is +y (2D screen space).

title: Conveyor belt
description: While something touches this trigger/collider it is pushed with a constant velocity along the given direction.

title: Destructible crate
description: Has hit points; takes 'damage' events and strong collisions, then breaks into debris prefabs and optionally drops loot. Emits 'destroyed'.

title: Drag & throw (2D)
description: Click an entity carrying this script to drag it with the pointer; releasing throws it with the pointer's velocity.

title: Explosion force
description: Call explode() (or emit the configured event) to push every body within the radius away from this entity with falloff. Optionally shakes the camera and destroys itself.

title: Magnet / gravity well
description: Attracts (or repels with negative strength) all entities with a tag within a radius, force falling off with distance.

title: Hinge door / slider
description: Opens/closes by tweening rotation (hinge) or position (slide). Toggle via the entity's 'interact' event or the 'open'/'close' entity events.

title: Hit-scan weapon (3D)
description: Fires an instant ray forward from the entity on 'fire' (rate-limited). The hit entity receives a 'damage' event {amount, from, point} and gets knocked back if it has a rigidbody.

title: Knockback receiver
description: Listens for 'damage' events carrying a source and shoves the entity away from it for a short stun, during which controllers should check entity.stunned.

title: Moving platform
description: Moves back and forth between its start and start+offset (sine or linear). Riders (anything standing on it with a rigidbody) are carried by applying the platform's delta.

title: One-way platform
description: Put on a platform entity: its collider only blocks things moving downward from above. Hold 'down' + 'jump' on the platform to drop through (body tagged 'player').

title: Pick up & carry
description: Press 'interact' near an entity tagged 'carryable' to carry it above the head; press again to drop (or 'fire' to throw it forward).

title: Projectile (ballistic / homing)
description: Put on a bullet prefab: flies along its rotation (z) at a speed, optionally curving toward the nearest entity with a target tag, dies after a lifetime or on hit and emits 'hit'.

title: Rope / chain (verlet)
description: Verlet rope anchored at this entity, drawn into a DOM-free debug line via the entity's 'points' array (read rope.points from another script, e.g. to move a hanging lamp). Pin the end to another entity by name.

title: Spawn bodies on click / key
description: Spawns a prefab at the pointer (2D) or in front of the entity (3D) on the 'fire' action or pointer click, with an optional cap so old bodies are recycled.

title: Trigger zone → event
description: Emits global events when tagged entities enter/leave this zone, optionally once. Great glue for checkpoints, cutscenes, doors.

title: Autotile (4-bit / 8-bit)
description: Picks edge tiles from neighbour bitmasks. Export autotile4(grid) / autotile8(grid) → grid of mask indices (0–15 / 0–255 mapped to 47-blob); the script applies a 16-tile 'blob-lite' tileset layout (index = mask) to the tilemap from a boolean grid.

title: Day–night cycle
description: Advances a time-of-day clock (hours) and tints the scene: 2D overlays a colour wash on the UI layer; 3D rotates a named directional light and changes its intensity. Emits 'time:hour' each in-game hour and 'time:night'/'time:day'.

title: Dungeon generator (BSP / cellular)
description: Generates a map with BSP rooms+corridors or cellular-automata caves and paints it into this entity's tilemap component (setTile). Also exports bsp(), cellular() returning a 2D array (1 = wall). Seeded: same seed → same map.

title: Fog of war
description: Grid fog overlay drawn in a DOM canvas above the game: cells within the viewer's radius are revealed and stay dimly remembered. Viewer = entity with this script; exposes revealed[][] for minimaps/saves.

title: Minimap
description: Corner radar: draws dots for entities with tags (player, enemy, pickup…) scaled from world to a small DOM canvas, centred on this entity.

title: Weather (rain / snow)
description: Full-screen rain or snow drawn on a DOM canvas overlay (no assets needed). Intensity can be changed live (set 'weather:set' event: {type, intensity}); lightning flash optional for rain.

title: CRT post effect
description: Fullscreen fragment shader (Phaser PostFX / Babylon PostProcess): barrel distortion, scanlines, RGB shift.

title: Dissolve
description: Alpha-clips by a noise threshold with a glowing edge. Animate uniform "amount" 0→1.

title: Fresnel rim light
description: Adds a coloured rim that strengthens at grazing angles.

title: Hologram
description: Fresnel rim + moving scanlines with additive-looking alpha.

title: Outline (inverted hull)
description: Render a slightly inflated back-face copy of the mesh with this material for a solid outline.

title: Scrolling UV
description: Scrolls a texture by (speed.x, speed.y) per second — conveyors, waterfalls, energy beams.

title: Toon (cel) shading
description: Babylon ShaderMaterial: banded diffuse lighting from a light direction uniform.

title: Triplanar terrain
description: Projects a tileable texture on three axes, blended by normal; no UVs needed.

title: Water (animated)
description: Scrolling distortion + highlight bands for a top-down or side water plane.

title: Wind sway (foliage)
description: Vertex shader bends geometry more with height; pair with any fragment colour/texture.

title: Floating damage numbers
description: Listens for 'damage' events on any entity with this tag and floats the amount upward (world → screen via the DOM overlay scaled to the 640×360-style view). Emit the global 'popup' {x,y,text,color} for custom numbers.

title: Game over / win screen
description: Shows a Game Over screen on the global 'game:over' (or the configured death event) and a You Win screen on 'game:win' (also 'wave:all-done'), with Restart. Shows the score if gameplay.score is present.

title: HUD: hearts, bars, score
description: Heads-up display bound to events: hearts or a health bar from the target's 'health' entity event, optional mana bar from the global 'mana' event, and a coin counter from 'pickup'. Put anywhere in the scene.

title: Inventory grid UI
description: Toggleable grid (action 'inventory', default key I via your input map) showing the Inventory script's slots with counts and a hover tooltip; click an item to equip it.

title: Level select
description: Grid of level buttons from a list of scene paths; levels unlock in order. Progress is stored via save. Emit 'level:complete' (index) to unlock the next one.

title: Loading screen
description: Shows a title + progress bar while scenes load (events 'sceneUnload' → show, 'sceneLoad' → hide). Call events.emit('loading:progress', 0..1) from custom loaders.

title: Main menu
description: Title screen with Play / Settings / Quit-to-title buttons. Play loads a scene (default: restart). Uses the project's UI theme. Pairs with ui.settings.

title: Pause menu
description: Toggle pause with Escape: freezes game time, shows Resume / Restart / Settings buttons. Also pauses on tab blur.

title: Settings screen
description: Volume sliders (master/music/sfx), fullscreen toggle and a back button. Values persist in the save store. Open with ui.show('settings').

title: Toast notifications
description: Small slide-in messages. Emit the global event 'toast' with a string (or {text,color,time}). Also announces quest completion, level-ups and pickups when enabled.

title: Virtual joystick & touch buttons
description: On-screen joystick (drives left/right/up/down) and up to two action buttons (e.g. jump, fire) for touch devices. Only shown on touch screens unless 'always' is set.

title: Marker (text prefab)
description: A labelled marker entity, handy for level layout.

title: Debug overlay & console
description: F3 (or backquote) toggles an FPS/entity-count overlay; backquote opens a tiny cheat console: type `emit eventName [json]`, `tp x y`, `timescale 0.5`, `scene path`. Add your own via commands.

title: Gamepad mapper & rebinding
description: Adds gamepad buttons to actions at runtime and supports key rebinding: events 'input:rebind' {action} waits for the next key press and stores it in the save file. Reapplies saved bindings on start.

title: Grid & geometry helpers
description: Pure helpers: Grid class (get/set/neighbors/flood fill/world↔cell), rect/circle/segment intersection tests, bezier(t,…pts), distance to segment. import { Grid, bezier, rectsOverlap } from './util-grid.js'.

title: Localisation (JSON)
description: Loads a JSON file per language ({"key": "text {name}"}) and updates every uiLabel/text component with a 'i18nKey' data field. Switch with events.emit('lang:set','de'). Remembers the choice.

title: Simplex / value noise
description: Seeded 2D simplex noise + fractal sum. import { makeNoise } from './util-noise.js'; const n = makeNoise(seed); n(x,y) → -1..1, n.fbm(x,y,octaves) → -1..1. The default script wobbles its entity with noise (camera-handheld look).

title: Object pool (bullets, particles)
description: Prefab pool: pool.get(pos) reuses a disabled instance instead of spawning, pool.release(entity) disables it. Avoids garbage/spawn cost for bullets. Other scripts: this.scene.find('Pool').getScript(Pool).

title: Screenshot & recorder
description: F12 saves a PNG of the canvas; F10 starts/stops a WebM recording (MediaRecorder on canvas.captureStream) and downloads it.

title: Procedural sfx (jsfxr-style)
description: Generates retro sound effects with WebAudio, no files needed: sfx(game,'coin'|'jump'|'hit'|'laser'|'explosion'|'powerup'). Listens to global events 'sfx' (name). import { sfx } from './util-sfx.js' for direct use.

title: Spin
description: Rotates the entity continuously around one axis.

title: Pause on blur, fullscreen key, local stats
description: Quality-of-life bundle: pauses audio+game when the tab loses focus, F toggles fullscreen, and counts local-only play stats (sessions, play time, deaths) into the save file. No network.

title: Tween animator (scale / move / fade)
description: Plays a configured tween on start: bob, pulse, move-by, or spin-in. Shows how to use this.tween() and the ease table (linear, quadOut, cubicInOut, sineInOut, backOut, elasticOut, bounceOut…).
